notes: Item labels are short paraphrases for navigation, not the questionnaire wording. Administer the published instrument itself.

instruments.label: PHQ-9
instruments.licence_note: PHQ instruments are free to use without permission (developed by Spitzer, Williams, Kroenke and colleagues).

items.label: Sleep difficulty or sleeping too much
Feeling bad about oneself or like a failure
Slowed movement or speech, or restlessness
Thoughts of self-harm or being better off dead

instruments.reliable_change_source: Löwe B, Unützer J, Callahan CM, Perkins AJ, Kroenke K. Monitoring depression treatment outcomes with the Patient Health Questionnaire-9. Medical Care 2004;42(12). Applied to the PHQ-8 subtotal as an assumption pending consultant verification.

instruments.label: GAD-7
instruments.licence_note: GAD-7 is free to use without permission (Spitzer, Kroenke, Williams, Löwe 2006).

items.label: Feeling nervous, anxious or on edge
Unable to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
So restless it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid something awful might happen

instruments.reliable_change_source: Not set; awaiting clinical consultant. No change markers are produced while null.

extension_point: Add an instrument only after its licence is confirmed (licence_confirmed: true). A mania/hypomania self-rating scale for bipolar monitoring is a planned candidate; its licence has not been checked.
